context_length: Trained on sequences of up to 512 tokens, with T5 relative position bias; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The large Ankh3 model: an Ankh-style T5 trained jointly on span denoising and sequence completion, from sequences alone. Its paper reports gains over Ankh and ESM-2 on secondary structure, fluorescence, GB1 fitness and contact prediction.
architecture: T5 encoder-decoder with 48 encoder and 24 decoder layers. Only the encoder is used here (1.15B parameters), giving 1536-dim per-residue embeddings. A task prefix, [NLU] for denoising or [S2S] for completion, selects the objective.
pretraining_data: 59.1M sequences from UniRef50, trained with T5x (JAX) on 64 TPUv4 chips.
pretraining_objective: Two objectives, one drawn per sequence: span denoising with 15, 20 or 30% of residues masked by sentinel tokens, and sequence completion, where the encoder reads the first part of a sequence and the decoder generates the rest.
key_innovations: Joint pretraining on span denoising at several masking rates and on sequence completion, from sequences alone
Reported gains over Ankh and ESM-2 on secondary structure, fluorescence, GB1 fitness and contact prediction, though not on every contact metric
when_to_use: When you want a recent sequence-only model at a 1536-dim embedding size.
caveats: 2025 preprint; weights under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial). Sequences were embedded here without a task prefix; the model card prepends [NLU], and the paper evaluates both [NLU] and [S2S], so these embeddings differ from the authors' setting.

citations.authors: Alsamkary, H., Elshaffei, M., Elkerdawy, M., Elnaggar, A.
citations.title: Ankh3: Multi-Task Pretraining with Sequence Denoising and Completion Enhances Protein Representations
